topic: BC Cancer Lung Screening Program reporting (BC Lung Screening Protocol v2.0, January 2026)
today: Not on the site. Program LDCTs in BC are reported with the PanCan risk score at baseline, volumetry and VDT at follow-up and categories 1–5 with different intervals (1: 2 years, 2: 1 year, 3: 3 months, 4–5: referral); the site has nothing on it. Its place depends on the lead choice (B1-lung-rads-01).

topic: CT technique for nodules (thin sections, reformats, low-dose follow-up, comparison with the earliest prior)
today: Fleischner 2017 gives graded recommendations (≤ 1.5 mm contiguous sections, typically 1 mm, with coronal and sagittal series; low-dose follow-up, CTDIvol ≤ 3 mGy in a standard-size patient; review priors including the earliest; journal pp230–232); the page has none.

topic: Nodules that need no follow-up (benign calcification, fat, typical intrapulmonary lymph node, apical scarring, 2-year stability)
today: Fleischner Figs 1, 2 and 5 (journal pp231, 233), stopping follow-up of benign-looking solid nodules stable at 12–18 months (p233), apical scarring (p240); the Choosing Wisely Canada 2026 recommendation 1 (abstract) says the same. The page has only the perifissural line and the calculator has no benign exit.

topic: Nodules on incomplete thoracic CT (neck, cardiac, abdominal CT)
today: Fleischner journal p240: < 6 mm, nothing further; 6–8 mm, complete chest CT at 3–12 months; large or very suspicious, complete chest CT now; partial thoracic scans not recommended for follow-up. Common on call; not on the page.

topic: Reporting incidental nodules (always give a recommendation, compare with the earliest scan)
